# Consumable stock API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

The lab's own stock of a consumable, such as a batch of virus or a box of probes, kept in an inventory.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/consumablestock/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/consumablestock/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `consumable_stock` (detail, create, update), `consumable_stocks` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `inventory` (from [`inventory`](/api/personal_attributes/inventory/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [ConsumableStock type](/api/schemas/consumablestock/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** refused (400) while [`materialusage`](/api/modules/materialusage/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [ConsumableStock types](/api/schemas/consumablestock/) **[required]** |
| `status` | one of `available`, `in_use`, `reserved`, `depleted`, `used`, `failed`, `expired`, `maintenance`, `discontinued`, `unknown` **[required]**. Current availability status of this consumable stock |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `inventory` | [`inventory`](/api/personal_attributes/inventory/) id **[required]** |
| `acquisition_date` | date; nullable |
| `expiration_date` | date; nullable |
| `storage_location` | string; max 100 characters; nullable |
| `storage_conditions` | string; max 100 characters; nullable |
| `intended_use` | string; max 100 characters; nullable |
| `cost` | string; max 100 characters; nullable |
| `consumable` | [`consumable`](/api/resources/consumable/) id **[required]** |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/consumablestock/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('consumablestock', load_all=True)
records = resp['consumable_stocks']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('consumablestock', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.consumable_stocks;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/consumablestock/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('consumablestock', data={"type": "AdhesiveCement", "status": "available", "inventory": "<inventory-id>", "consumable": "<consumable-id>", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}})
record = resp.json()['consumable_stock']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'AdhesiveCement', 'status', 'available', 'inventory', '<inventory-id>', 'consumable', '<consumable-id>', 'details', struct()), 'consumablestock');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.consumable_stock;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/consumablestock/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('consumablestock', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['consumable_stock']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('consumablestock', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.consumable_stock;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/consumablestock/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('consumablestock', id='<id>', data={"notes": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'notes', 'new value'), 'consumablestock', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/consumablestock/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('consumablestock', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'consumablestock');
```
